about_the_game:
Meet Casey!

Casey isn't your typical chick in a bikini. She's a street-slick wildcat with scraped knees, a cocky grin and an ass so tight you'd recognize it in a crowd. She spits on rules, laughs in authority's face and always leaves behind the stench of burnt rubber and a fresh warrant for her arrest.

She's a real firecracker — she'll drop low, spread those legs, arch her back just so you notice there's no underwear in sight. Then she'll pop her gum loud, wink, and purr, "Time for a ride, baby." She doesn't give a damn about laws, order or playing nice. Casey lives like she fucks — rough, dirty, and loud.


What You Get?

Add Casey to your collection and try taming this wicked, irresistible outlaw. You can change your mascot anytime — just head to your profile in-game and select the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you'll also receive 5000 Credits and 150 Super Serum.

But most importantly, you'll have our heartfelt thanks! We truly appreciate your support and hope you enjoy this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
